newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps-Gas oil supported at $25.00/BBL.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps-Gas oil supported at $25.00/BBL.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps were steady at midday on Tuesday as the market consolidated at around the $25.00 per barrel mark with strong support seen at this mark, traders said.
"Gas oil is steady, everytime prices threathen to the $25.00 mark alot of buyers emerge," said a trader.
May gas oil swaps were last quoted $25.05/$25.15 per barrel, down five cents from Monday's quotes with no trades confirmed this morning.

Traders said the market is relieved by the gradual fall in prices with some still holding on to the belief that physical prices will also gain alot of support at the $25.00 per barrel free-on-board Singapore mark.
Physical prices were slowly declining since mid-March as three traders, who have among them have bought more than 18 million barrels of gas oil since March 3, consistently bid at lower levels.
On Monday the bid was at $25.30 per barrel with one 150,000-barrel cargo traded at this level, down 20 cents from Friday's traded level.
Fuel oil swaps were unchanged with May seen at $99.00/$100.00, brokers said.
